description: Locks in the current roster-color property: removing a PLAYER (PLAYER_LEFT) frees their seat color for a new player, and a later re-add does NOT automatically reclaim the old color -- colorNumber lives entirely on the ROLE_ASSIGNED event itself, not derived at fold time. join_order (and so turn-order 'number') still survives a leave/re-add unchanged. Replayed by RosterReducerTest#fixtureRoundTripMatchesServer, which folds these events via apply() and then calls syncFromRoster(expectedRoster), mirroring RunePartyPlugin's real live flow.
